c.v: The encryption or decryption key is stored in AES_KEY_n_REG, which is a set of eight
The plaintext and ciphertext are stored in AES_TEXT_IN_m_REG and AES_TEXT_OUT_m_REG, which are two sets of four
For AES-128/AES-256 encryption, the AES_TEXT_IN_m_REG registers are initialized with plaintext.
Then, the AES Accelerator stores the ciphertext into AES_TEXT_OUT_m_REG after operation.
For AES-128/AES-256 decryption, the AES_TEXT_IN_m_REG registers are initialized with ciphertext.
Then, the AES Accelerator stores the plaintext into AES_TEXT_OUT_m_REG after operation.
